text: Marla City stays split down the middle: Flint drags Vale to the intake valve demanding pressure numbers and mocking chamomile tea and wildflowers as "sentimental fluff," while Reed and Lumen head to the orchards to sit with Elias like a scared friend instead of a broken machine. Dusk pushes ahead alone on a tiny herb garden by the western wall, calling it proof that Marla City needs healing, not just yield reports — and even Flint grudgingly lets it slide. The twist: Vale, the data girl, finally cracks a little and agrees to spend fifteen minutes checking out Dusk's garden before the valve meeting, meaning for the first time she's chasing both camps instead of just one.
